title: Castlevania: Bloodlines - Versailles Palace (Wine Cellar)
description:
One of the backgrounds seen in the Versailles Palace, from Castlevania: Bloodlines.

A very simple and user friendly background that takes very little graphic space, meaning the user can combine it with various other graphics if they want to.

A good fit for a castle sub-area, in general.
